draw_line_to_bronze_chests.label: 青銅の宝箱に線を引く
draw_line_to_bronze_chests.tooltip: 戦闘中でない間、キャラクターの位置から近くの青銅の宝箱に線を描画します。

draw_line_to_silver_chests.label: 白銀の宝箱に線を引く
draw_line_to_silver_chests.tooltip: 戦闘中でない間、キャラクターの位置から近くの白銀の宝箱に線を描画します。

show_spirit_pot_prediction.label: 壺の宝予測を表示
show_spirit_pot_prediction.tooltip: 壺が示す方角と距離から、北島ルートマップに予測範囲と候補地点を表示します

cast_treasure_sight_before_hunt.label: 宝探し開始前にマギトレジャーサーチを使用
cast_treasure_sight_before_hunt.tooltip: マウントを降り、フリーランサーに切り替えて使用後、元のサポートジョブへ戻します

cast_treasure_sight_upon_return.label: 帰還後にトレジャーサーチを使用する
cast_treasure_sight_upon_return.tooltip: FATEやCEの後にベースキャンプへ戻った際、宝箱の数を更新するためにマギトレジャーサーチを使用します

show_percentage_active_treasure_count.label: アクティブな宝箱をパーセンテージで表示
show_percentage_active_treasure_count.tooltip: 全体数の横にアクティブな宝箱の割合を表示します

treasure_sight_every_n_locations.label: Treasure Sight every N spots
treasure_sight_every_n_locations.tooltip: Recast Treasure Sight after checking this many coffer spots. 0 disables.

hunt_silver_chests_only.label: Silver coffers only
hunt_silver_chests_only.tooltip: Only route through silver coffer spots. North Horn route spots carry no coffer type, so this does nothing there.

skip_unsafe_treasure_windows.label: Wait out unsafe South Horn windows
skip_unsafe_treasure_windows.tooltip: During South Horn's night (ET 22:30 to 4:00) or dangerous weather, finish the current spot and wait until it is safe.

return_to_base_camp_after_hunt.label: Return to camp after the hunt
return_to_base_camp_after_hunt.tooltip: Return to base camp when the route is done or no coffers are left.

play_sound_on_hunt_complete.label: Sound when the hunt finishes
play_sound_on_hunt_complete.tooltip: Play a sound when the route is done or no coffers are left.

hunt_min_bronze_percent.label: Auto hunt: minimum bronze (%)
hunt_min_bronze_percent.tooltip: The hunt between activities starts once bronze coffers (out of 30) reach this share; bronze or silver is enough.

hunt_min_silver_percent.label: Auto hunt: minimum silver (%)
hunt_min_silver_percent.tooltip: The hunt between activities starts once silver coffers (out of 8) reach this share; with silver only, silver alone decides.

use_south_horn_authored_route.label: Use the authored South Horn route
use_south_horn_authored_route.tooltip: In South Horn, visit coffers in the hand-authored area order (base camp, Wanderer's Haven, Crystallized Caverns, Eldergrowth, Stonemarsh) instead of a freshly computed route. Pick the starting area in the hunt panel.

panel.none: 近くに宝箱はありません。
panel.detecting_detail: 最初のリアルタイム読み取り後に宝箱数を表示します。
